# AWS Network Firewall

Store Network Firewall rule groups, policies, firewalls, and logging configurations without packet inspection or endpoint network provisioning.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `networkfirewall` |
| Signing name | `network-firewall` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.0 |
| API version | `2020-11-12` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 31 of 85 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-network-firewall) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Records only: no packet inspection, Suricata engine execution, traffic filtering, VPC route table updates, or actual ENI network data plane endpoints.
- VPC endpoints and sync states are deterministic mock records reporting READY status.
- TLS inspection configurations and rule group analysis/summary metrics are outside the subset.
- Transit gateway attached firewalls are not supported: CreateFirewall requires VpcId and SubnetMappings.
- Enabled TLS session holding fails explicitly because TLS inspection is outside the subset.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
